knowledge_types.definition: A self-contained, validated operational pattern operating on a single architectural boundary in isolation (e.g. BKM-CANARY-001).
A multi-pattern architecture composed of two or more atomic BKMs that yields proven non-trivial synergy (e.g. BKM-COMPOSITION-CANARY-001).
A composite knowledge structure where constituent execution order determines success vs degradation (e.g. A -> B outperforms B -> A by +30%).
A counter-indicated anti-pattern with proven empirical failure consequences that enforces strict execution prohibition (e.g. NEG-BKM-001).
A contextual pattern valid exclusively when specific external boundary constraints (e.g. debouncing, max payload) are satisfied.
